name: @lenticule-science/condenser-research
description: Condenser Research: the study of the participation economy, the economy in which a person earns by participating rather than by wage, salary, contract, or gig, and of earning without buying as its first public services: the literatures that actually cover it, the surfaces and their rules, the anti-bot economics, and the labor-hour truth, every figure cited to a first-party source with its date.
